layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 and p-12 for section breathing room.
layout_spacing.event_cards: rounded-2xl p-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-gray-300

components.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-gray-200/50 sticky top-0 z-50 py-4
components.tabs: Floating pill style. Override standard Shadcn tabs. Use rounded-full bg-gray-100 p-1, active tab gets bg-white shadow-sm rounded-full.
components.buttons: rounded-xl font-medium px-6 py-3 transition-colors. Primary is black, Secondary is bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-black.
components.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

interactions.hover: Smooth transform translations and soft ambient shadow increases.

images.description: Minimalist light square texture for subtle hero banner background to give premium feel.
Black notebooks and pen on white surface for Focus Time / Execution sessions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the event platform using React, Tailwind CSS, and customized Shadcn components.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body fonts. Add them via Google Fonts or standard @font-face imports.
Do NOT use standard boring list views. Render events as premium cards (rounded-2xl) with clean typography, clear date/time blocks, and tiered badges (Free, Standard, Accelerator).
Build a custom Focus Time System widget mimicking a 'Control Room' dense grid, allowing users to define weekly focus times.
Add Phosphor icons (e.g., CalendarPlus, CalendarBlank, VideoCamera) for 1-click Google/Outlook calendar integration.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Use a tabbed interface (Live Events, Replays, Focus Sessions) utilizing custom pill-shaped tabs rather than standard underlines.
Header must use Crystal Glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70).
